name: Solve and create riddles and logic puzzles
description: Users asked to solve, create, or analyze a wide variety of riddles, logic puzzles, word games, and brain teasers. The requests ranged from solving classic trick questions regarding birds or locks to inventing new riddles, designing crossword puzzles, and interpreting cryptic clues based on specific scenarios.
